resources.string: Setup is unfinished, so a recording may be cut short without warning. You can still record.
Required — a track is nothing but a stream of location fixes.
Lets recording carry on once the app leaves the screen.
Required — the recording has to be visible while it runs.
Keeps Android from putting the recorder to sleep.
%1$s restricts background apps beyond Android\'s own rules, and a long recording may not survive its defaults.

Freemap Tracker records your location — including while the app is closed or not in use — for as long as a recording is running, and for no other reason.\n\nFixes are written to this device only, into the app\'s private storage. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
Android will not offer this in a prompt, so it has to be set by hand.\n\nOn the next screen open Permissions → Location and choose \"Allow all the time\".

Android puts apps to sleep to save power. A sleeping recorder records nothing, and it is not told to stop — the track simply ends where the phone decided it should, usually with no warning at all.\n\nAllowing unrestricted battery use is what keeps a long recording intact.
Denied for good — turn it on under Permissions in app settings.
Could not open that settings screen on this device.

The one that matters: Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Freemap Tracker → Battery saver, set to No restrictions.

It also helps to lock the app in Recents, so clearing recent apps does not take the recording with it.

Autostart, on the same app screen, is not what keeps a running recording alive — it only decides whether MIUI may start the app again after killing it. Worth switching on, but it is not the fix.
Open Phone Manager → App launch, switch Freemap Tracker from Manage automatically to Manage manually, and turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
Open Settings → Battery → Background usage limits, turn off Put unused apps to sleep, and make sure Freemap Tracker is in neither the Sleeping nor the Deep sleeping list.
Open Settings → Battery → App battery management and allow Freemap Tracker to run in the background.\n\nThen, in the phone manager\'s Startup manager, allow it to auto-start.
Open iManager → App manager → Autostart manager and enable Freemap Tracker.\n\nThen, under Battery → High background power consumption, allow it as well.
Open Settings → Battery → Battery optimisation and set Freemap Tracker to Don\'t optimise.\n\nIf your version has Advanced optimisation, turn off Deep optimisation and Sleep standby optimisation.
